ValidationRule.description: A drive in a 'Cancel' status should not be allowed to move back to prior drive status
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISNEW()) && ISCHANGED(sked_Status__c) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(sked_Status__c), "Cancel") && NOT(ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c, "Cancel")) && $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'Global Admin'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A cancelled drive cannot be moved back to another drive status.
